observations.body: The wilderness becomes the setting for speech, vineyards, and a renewed response.

payload.posture: Read Hosea 2:12–16 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The same setting can hold both exposure and promise without erasing the earlier rupture.
